purpose: Historical source origins, import commits and adaptation scope. Current dependency restoration is specified by the lock files under tools/.

imports.scope: Pinned portable build tools and Windows build environment; collection paths and audit are independent.

Accepted G2 maintenance source, SDK and 22 dependency pins; reorganized by scripts/import_g2_sources.py. Original files were checked against committed Git blobs and SHA-256. No game data, generated game bodies or installed tools are imported. Earlier SDK provenance and import file hashes are archived in docs/provenance/sdk-import-baseline.json; tools/sdk-source.lock.json contains current dependency pins only.

Read-only XEX inventory, static census, callback/run analysis and G2-specific community analysis adapted to collection inputs and output boundaries. Original 66 Python test cases are mapped in docs/ANALYSIS.md: 64 remain Python checks; two copy checks are covered by the collection native DataImport implementation and tests. No second legacy configuration or game import implementation is retained.

Online SQLite snapshot and seven-backup retention adapted into server/backup.py, with exclusive output creation, regular input checks and explicit connection cleanup. Collection deployment templates keep each game database and legacy API separate.

Pinned Futari compatibility, audio scheduling and tracing, native community/outbox/replay source, generator declarations and regressions, reorganized under games/futari and tests/futari. 39 initial files were verified against committed Git blobs before copying; GUI settings, old host, SDK duplicates and game bodies are excluded. Resident callback declarations are split into default-functions.toml without changing addresses. HTTP transport and nickname validation now use common/community; native transfer faults run only against a disposable loopback server. Server source is preserved under server/games/futari.py; deployment is not changed by this import.
